capabilities.name: set_url
capabilities.doc: Set the C2 server URL in NVS. Severing: a wrong URL strands the device from C2 (USB recovery only).

capabilities.name: set_wifi
capabilities.doc: Replace the primary Wi-Fi credentials in NVS. Severing: wrong credentials strand the device (USB recovery only).

capabilities.name: wifi_add
capabilities.doc: Add a Wi-Fi network to the multi-AP store (additive; optional priority).

capabilities.name: nvs_set
capabilities.doc: Write a string to an arbitrary NVS namespace/key. Severing: overwriting the C2 URL or Wi-Fi keys strands the device.

capabilities.name: net_clear
capabilities.doc: Clear the cached network/BSSID association hints. Severing if it drops the only path back to C2.

capabilities.name: tx_power
capabilities.doc: Get the Wi-Fi TX power in dBm; set it when given an argument (hard-capped on-device).

capabilities.name: ip
capabilities.doc: Current IP address, or nil if not connected.

capabilities.name: ssid
capabilities.doc: Current associated SSID, or nil.

capabilities.name: rssi
capabilities.doc: Current RSSI in dBm, or nil.

capabilities.name: connected
capabilities.doc: True if the Wi-Fi link is up.

capabilities.name: reboot
capabilities.doc: Reboot the device after the poll completes (the ack persists first). Self-disconnecting: feedback waits for the next poll.

capabilities.name: refresh
capabilities.doc: Force an EPD full refresh after the poll completes.

capabilities.name: device_sleep
capabilities.doc: Deep-sleep for s seconds (0 = default cadence; clamped to 24h on-device). Self-disconnecting: feedback waits for the next wake/poll.

capabilities.name: store_set
capabilities.doc: Persist a value to the on-device key/value store (flash-backed).

capabilities.name: store_get
capabilities.doc: Read a value from the store, or nil if absent.

capabilities.name: store_del
capabilities.doc: Delete a store key.

capabilities.name: store_has
capabilities.doc: True if the store holds the key.

capabilities.name: store_keys
capabilities.doc: List store keys, optionally filtered by prefix.

capabilities.name: store_ok
capabilities.doc: True if the persistent store mounted successfully.

capabilities.name: rtc_set
capabilities.doc: Persist a value to RTC memory (survives deep sleep, not power loss).

capabilities.name: rtc_get
capabilities.doc: Read a value from RTC memory, or nil.

capabilities.name: rtc_del
capabilities.doc: Delete an RTC-memory key.

capabilities.name: rtc_has
capabilities.doc: True if RTC memory holds the key.

capabilities.name: dev_mac
capabilities.doc: Wi-Fi station MAC address.

capabilities.name: dev_bt_mac
capabilities.doc: Bluetooth MAC address.

capabilities.name: nvs_str
capabilities.doc: Read-only string read from an NVS namespace/key, or nil.

capabilities.name: dev_chip
capabilities.doc: Chip model string.

capabilities.name: dev_uptime_ms
capabilities.doc: Milliseconds since boot.

capabilities.name: dev_reset
capabilities.doc: Last reset reason.

capabilities.name: dev_batt_mv
capabilities.doc: Battery voltage in millivolts.

capabilities.name: dev_batt_pct
capabilities.doc: Battery charge percentage.

capabilities.name: dev_usb_connected
capabilities.doc: True if USB is connected.

capabilities.name: dev_boots
capabilities.doc: Reset-proof total boot count.

capabilities.name: dev_bad_boots
capabilities.doc: Consecutive bad-boot count tracked by the recovery guard.

capabilities.name: dev_guard_threshold
capabilities.doc: Recovery-guard bad-boot threshold.

capabilities.name: dev_logbuf
capabilities.doc: Recent on-device log ring as text.
